Scenario fixture: a11ycore-meta-refresh-timing-absent

01 — FAIL: meta refresh with a 5-second delay

This rule inspects the document's own <meta http-equiv="refresh"> tag, so only one scenario can be demonstrated per page. The PASS case (delay="0", an immediate redirect) and the not-applicable case (no meta refresh tag at all) are covered by the inline unit tests in this rule's .test.js file rather than a second fixture file.
